title: Formalization of Scott's Measurement Structures and Linear Inequalities in Lean 4
summary: A Lean 4 / mathlib formalization of Dana Scott's 1964 paper *Measurement Structures and Linear Inequalities* (Journal of Mathematical Psychology 1 (1964), 233–247). The paper derives necessary and sufficient conditions for three finite representation problems — intransitive indifference, ordered differences, and subjective probability — from the general solvability criterion for finite systems of linear inequalities.
